purpose: Pre-live function proposals, synthetic realistic examples, no measured superiority claims
variantsContract: The same statement strings and evaluation order are preserved across size variants. Small uses a compact one-line signature with readable single statements; largeAdjacent expands the signature; largeSeparated uses natural computation/classification/effect paragraphs. Size treatment is modest: these are formatting controls with substantial domain bodies, not unrelated filler. Clean has equivalent behavior with explicit resource arguments.

cases.domain: Reservation decisions prioritize temporary closure, expired holds, then insufficient inventory. An active hold expires at its deadline. Inventory decreases only for an available booking; reference and trimmed presentation description are preserved.

probes.retainedFacts: reference unchanged; label trimmed; remainingSeats=4 requestedSeats=2 -> seatsAfterBooking=2 only for available; all other statuses ->4
probes.resourceProof: Freeze hidden Date.now at 1000 while supplying clock.now=99; corrected function must return available for deadline100. Spy supplied clock exactly once.

cases.domain: Invoice aging preserves the unpaid balance, invoice identity and trimmed presentation description. Paid invoices are settled, unpaid disputed invoices are disputed, and other unpaid invoices become overdue at dueAt plus the grace interval.

probes.priority: settled dominates disputed/overdue; disputed dominates overdue when balance>0; overpayment balance clamps to0
probes.resourceProof: Hidden Date.now=1000, explicit clock.now=109 => open, one clock read. Preserve invoiceId and balance.

cases.domain: Each moderation decision records submission ID, selected status and exact original text once, including rejected and empty submissions. The returned text is trimmed. Empty, excessive length and blocked terms take precedence in that order. Matching is case insensitive.
